title: Portfolio bootstrap stub
description: Bootstrap-time-only placeholder shape for the four .agents/portfolio/*.json files a github-portfolio-control consumer bootstrap seeds. A stub carries zero observed items: it exists so the four files are present and schema-valid on the day of bootstrap, before any snapshot, acceptance, multigraph or dispatch run has ever produced real content. It is not the runtime schema for a populated file of the same name -- that contract is owned by whichever Skill first runs a real snapshot/acceptance/multigraph/dispatch cycle against this consumer, and is expected to be a stricter, non-empty shape.

epoch_subject.description: The consumer's own {main_commit, tree} at the moment the stub was seeded -- never the skills-shared subject, which lives in the sibling control-plane source/profile pins.

items.description: Always empty in a bootstrap-seeded stub. A non-empty items array is real observed state and must be produced by the owning Skill's own runtime, never by this bootstrap.
